purpose: locfix1: locationd self-deadlock fix. locdiag1 showed every locationd instance stuck: CLEmergencyController's constructor (silo thread) calls +[CLLocationManager authorizationStatusForBundle:] = a synchronous XPC call to locationd's own com.apple.locationd.synchronous, while the main thread waits in dispatch_sync on the same silo. Patched /usr/libexec/locationd (gpu/hwcodec/locfix/patch_locationd.py): the 3 in-daemon calls of authorizationStatusForBundle:/ForBundlePath: (0x1006ef17c, 0x100f8bab0, 0x100f87870) return 3; ad-hoc CodeDirectory kept, 3 page hashes recomputed, entitlements untouched. Original kept in /private/var/db/nord2-locfix/locationd.orig. Undo: guest-locfix1-undo.sh + payload-locfix1-undo + owned-locfix1.json.
